name: Fable Barbell
strategy: Risk-balanced barbell: 46% aggressive AI-infra compounders plus a small 2x contrarian BTC perp, against 38% defensive ballast (quality/staples/gold/utilities plus a 3% SOXL short as convexity hedge) and 18% yielding cash.

positions.thesis: Aggressive: AI-infra anchor with datacenter capex still accelerating into H2
Aggressive: custom-ASIC/networking AI winner with software cash flows cushioning semi beta
Aggressive: AI power-demand pick-and-shovel; multi-year backlog, less crowded than chips
Aggressive: AI networking share gainer; buying the correction dip in a proven H1 name
Aggressive: small contrarian mean-reversion long after -27% H1; 2x on 3% margin caps loss at 3% of NAV
Ballast: cash-rich diversified compounder; best-in-class drawdown defense in both test windows
Ballast: staples cash-flow stability, low beta to AI-trade unwinds
Ballast: cheap defensive pharma, uncorrelated to tech capex cycle
Ballast: AAA-quality healthcare defensive that held bid through both stress windows
Ballast: crisis hedge entered 6.5% off highs; rallied through the 2025 tariff crash
Ballast: utilities defensiveness with a back-door AI power-demand kicker
Ballast hedge: short 3x-levered semis after +250% H1 - convex crash protection plus volatility-decay tailwind

backtest.notes: Barbell max drawdown -15.8%/-7.6% vs -40%/-15% for the aggressive sleeve alone - ballast cut DD by ~50-60%. The 3% BTC perp backtests negative by construction (the crash IS the entry thesis); the SOXL short cost 3-7pts in the 2026H1 semi bull and only pays in a correction.

outlook: AI-infra earnings momentum intact but positioning stretched; return engine stays long NVDA/AVGO/GEV/ANET while ballast, gold, cash, and a convex SOXL short absorb an April-style air pocket.
